QuestInfo.name: Pia and the Blue Mushroom
QuestInfo.1: Under the watchtower in Henesys Park, you see Pia, wearing a teddy bear costume. How cute! She tells you that she ran into a bully #o2220100# on her way to Ellinia, and now she wants you to show the rude mushroom who's boss! Collect #b10 #t4000009#s and 10 #t4000012#s#k as proof. You contemplate telling Pia she's asking to be teased, walking around the forest in a bear costume, but you decide against it.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered #b10 #t4000009#s and 10 #t4000012#s#k to Pia in Henesys Park. She was thrilled that she got vengeance on the mushrooms and gave you a Scroll for defense. All you have to do is click on it in the Use tab of your Item Inventory and drag it to your helmet in the Equipment window... Oh, and you'll have to cross your fingers and hope the Scroll doesn't fail.

0.0: Whew... I had the most difficult time when I ran into a #o2220100# the other day. It was so frustrating! If only I had more strength... I would've showed them what for!
0.1: Whoa! You look pretty strong! How about you take care of those bullies for me? Bring me #e10#n #b#t4000009#s#k and #e10#n #b#t4000012#s#k as proof, and I'll give you something in return... Something really sweet! Yeah!

1.0: HEY! In your hand... Those are the #b#t4000009#s#k and #b#t4000012#s#k I asked for? You got so many! Thank you! I feel soo much better. Muahaha, take that, mushrooms. Right back at ya, punks!
1.1: Oh yeah. This isn't much, but take it. Great work!

yes.0: This scroll... I believe it can strengthen your helmet. It's easy to use, too. Just open the Use tab of your Item Inventory and open your Equipment Inventory at the same time, then drag the scroll onto your helmet. There's a chance the scroll will fail, but life's risky like that...

item.0: I'll give you something really nice if you bring me #e20#n #b#t4000009#s#k and #e20#n #b#t4000012#s#k. I always keep my word! Honest!
